spotlight.title: Pre-spend gate = the launch gate: Analytics + Meta MCP, before dollar one
spotlight.detail: On T-0 these two stop being prep and become the go/no-go itself. Vercel Analytics still isn't confirmed on — Frankie's question, 'is anyone visiting the site?', stays unanswerable, and paid traffic without it makes the whole $600 unmeasurable and un-learnable (the free tier answers the question; no overspend needed). Then connect the Meta MCP and walk the campaign structure, or the creatives can't be pushed or monitored programmatically and the budget is driven by hand. Both must be TRUE before the first dollar moves. Build discipline carries in: never raise budget >20-25% inside 3-4 days (Andromeda relearns), refresh creatives ~every 15 days.

spotlight.title: The anti-ban trio + the video kit — nothing goes live without all three
spotlight.detail: Five minutes that gate the entire launch: your NPN, your CA producer-licence number, and the not-guaranteed / rates-vary disclaimer, on every creative AND the landing page. The old account was banned for exactly their absence — no licence identifiers, a guaranteed-sounding price teaser, an all-text PNG — so on launch day this is the hard compliance gate, not a nicety. And the video kit is still your whole allocation and still hasn't landed: one 20-24 min session (shirt + tie, iPhone 4K/60fps) unblocks the founder-ad creative, a creative with your face, the landing-page refresh and the ElevenLabs voice clone (audio is pulled from the same takes) — then hand the footage to Chitraksh.

spotlight.title: Launch-morning GO / NO-GO — hold the spend if any gate is still open
spotlight.detail: The capstone call for today: fire the $600 only when all of the above are closed — Analytics live, Meta MCP connected, compliance furniture on every creative and the landing page, static compliant creatives with no guaranteed-price language. If any is still open at the end of Frankie's morning, HOLD the spend: the $600 doesn't expire, but the account reputation does, and re-earning it after a second ban costs far more than a one-day slip. Same breath, settle W14 — the VC-connect phantom went quiet (no fire since Aug 8 10:07Z) and its verify link is dead, but decide it OFF before any cookie repair, because a fixed cookie just resumes the auto-connects PhantomBuster was marketing to you this very morning. And LinkedIn Batch 1 (28 days unposted) still gates every sequence, cookie or no cookie.
